description: This file defines and exports a list of optional bundled cluster identifiers, along with functions to check cluster inclusion, environment configurations, and features related to optional bundled clusters within the build process.

methods.name: isOptionalBundledCluster
methods.description: Checks if a given cluster name exists within the set of optional bundled clusters.

methods.name: shouldIncludeOptionalBundledClusters
methods.description: Determines if optional bundled clusters should be included based on environment variables, defaulting to process.env.

methods.name: hasReleasedBundledInstall
methods.description: Checks if the packageJson specifies a non-empty 'npmSpec' for openclaw install, indicating a released bundled install.

methods.name: shouldBuildBundledCluster
methods.description: Decides whether to build a specified cluster based on release status, environment settings, and whether the cluster is optional.
